# Stillharbour - Implementation evidence log

This log retains checkpoint-specific implementation and validation evidence, including failures and earlier specification-only notes. Current work is M6 release hardening; see [M6 readiness](M6_RELEASE_READINESS.md) and its evidence matrix for the current gate. Earlier milestone status statements describe their dated checkpoints, not the present implementation.

## M0 — foundation implementation, 2026-10-27

**Approved scope:** docs/CODEX_START_PROMPT.md and tasks/M0_FOUNDATION.md only. The initial specification-only state and template above are retained as history. No M1 or N1–N5 feature was implemented; no real photo folder was scanned or mutated.

**Environment:** local Conductor worktree, macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), arm64 Apple M1 Max, 10 physical CPU cores, 32 GiB RAM; Apple Command Line Tools. Node 26.3.1 / npm 11.16.0 were present. Rust was absent; installed rustup with Rust 1.99.1, rustfmt and clippy without modifying shell profiles. Native helpers were absent from PATH. Homebrew verified development helper bottles, extracted only under `.context/helpers`. No throughput, latency, memory-budget or million-row performance benchmark is claimed.

**Files changed:** root Cargo workspace/toolchain/lockfile and npm/Vite/TypeScript/ESLint/Prettier configuration; `crates/core` modules, fixture examples and media-process tests; `src-tauri` native command, capabilities, configs and derived desktop icons; `src` shell, generated bindings and component tests; `scripts` development/check/helper probes; `tests/desktop` and `.github/workflows/check.yml`; `.conductor/settings.toml`; README development entry, PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, DEPENDENCIES.md, SKILLS.md and ADR-0001. The previously supplied specification, task files and logo remain present. Logo SHA-256 is `91186d1b3e6ece2342789a6c04b8a050cc047cb280e88b7c7014580cf72b6d9d`; its SVG was not edited. Reference photos are not imported or packaged.

**Material decisions:** [ADR-0001](decisions/ADR-0001-stack.md) records the modular monolith, exact versions, Rust-owned IPC schema, bounded catalog/job/media boundaries, fail-closed native primitives, test isolation, provisional deployment target and deferred codecs/map/virtualization. TypeScript 7 was rejected because the current linter only supports versions below 6.1. The production app has no filesystem/shell/SQL renderer permission, backup adapter invocation or original-mutation command.

**Corrected failures:** besides dependency/icon setup, initial tests caught a snapshot test checking for WAL after deliberately reopening writable, a filesystem fixture using invalid UTF-8 that macOS refuses, Serde unit variants ignoring extra request fields, thumbnail upscaling, a child timeout too short for cold process launch, rclone's encoded newline listing, a missing test-only global Tauri API, and a nested npm command missing Cargo's `--` argument separator. Fixtures, contract and scripts were corrected; final check and native suites passed. Initial failures are not evidence of passing behavior.

**Artifacts:** command logs, advisory/license metadata and helper receipts are under gitignored `.context/evidence`; native screenshots are `.context/screenshots/native-foundation.png` and `native-minimum.png`. Reproduce them with the documented commands. The implementation log carries the durable evidence summary; local logs are not assumed available on other machines.

### Remaining gates and next milestone

- AC-001 is partial: a real macOS shell and typed Rust round trip passed; **native picker selection/cancel and Windows still require validation**. `osascript` reported OS accessibility UI automation disabled. No permission bypass or fake picker success was used.
- AC-013/014 have developer-helper evidence; AC-015 has baseline decoder-process evidence. These do not establish bundled ExifTool, every malformed-media format, broad color management or all metadata-worker recovery cases.
- AC-027 and AC-037 have a macOS/disposable feasibility subset. Interruption states were simulated at boundaries, not hard-power-loss tests or a production executor. Handle-relative ancestor containment, Windows native primitives, journal crash fault injection, metadata fidelity, independence and exact-version recovery remain blockers for real-library mutations.
- AC-077/078/080 remain distribution gates: clean Windows/macOS machines, a verified oldest macOS minimum, complete per-architecture helper/runtime/codecs and notices, owner-controlled bundle identity, Developer ID/Windows signing, notarization and updater verification. The provisional macOS 13 target is not a support promise. No credentials were available or requested for distribution signing.
- No remote protocol server was tested; M4 needs actual server/identity/TLS/interruption/restore/pacing tests for each advertised transport. Rclone's filename encoding requires a reviewed round-trip adapter. Local same-device restic recovery does not satisfy independent recovery evidence.
- Dependency development advisories remain documented; no broad security-complete claim. Full workflow screen-reader/manual keyboard checks, real gallery performance and million-row queries remain later tests. No map tiles, RAW/HEIC provider, provider import, catalog import/editor or mobile feature is exposed.

**Next approval gate:** review this M0 foundation and its unresolved native/helper gates before tasks/M1_READ_ONLY_LIBRARY.md. M1 is separately authorised; M2/M3 production original-file mutations stay blocked until the preservation/executor/recovery gates pass.

## 2026-10-27 — Start the next phase: M1 read-only library

**Request and scope:** the owner authorised the next phase after M0. Implemented `tasks/M1_READ_ONLY_LIBRARY.md` locally on macOS Apple Silicon, while retaining all original-file mutation/recovery gates. Windows and distribution gates remain open. Every resulting requirement, behavior, command and limitation is recorded in the linked documentation.

**Delivered:** native Save & Start scanning; persistent base/additional referenced or managed roots; native volume/root identity, overlap and explicit content-sampled relink; independent hidden and bounded pattern/size/date filters; streaming read-only traversal, batched catalog commits, partial results, cancellation/issues and restart/reconnect reconciliation. Schema 2 preserves catalog UUIDs and retains a consistent pre-migration snapshot. A unique one-link external rename can retain asset ID/first-added date; ambiguous locations remain separate.

The delivered gallery, uniform grid and actual text-only list share bounded keyset pages, filters, selection and anchor. Year navigation seeks directly through an index. Select all results freezes unloaded membership in SQLite. Inspector exposes raw/date/offset provenance, dimensions, availability and possible companions; favorites/ratings/tags update the catalog only. Map, file utilities, saved albums beyond tags, backup and mutations remain unavailable. Pinned branding and the owner's simplified initial screen remain intact.

**Implementation and decisions:** added `crates/core/src/library/`, generated library/probe fixtures and safety integration tests; extended the existing catalog actor, media worker and typed IPC instead of adding competing adapters. Updated `src/App.tsx`, `src/ipc.ts`, `src/styles.css`, `src/library/`, generated bindings and Tauri commands/capabilities/resources. Pinned TanStack Virtual, globset, BLAKE3, chrono and rustix; enabled WebP. Vendored checked ExifTool 13.55 code/notices/licenses and a resource hash manifest. Decoder children run the packaged app's early stdin-worker mode. Helpers receive bounded bytes, fixed arguments, no configuration discovery and no renderer-supplied original path. The 256 MiB cache serves known PNG IDs through a restricted protocol and never replaces an unexpected file.

[ADR-0002](decisions/ADR-0002-read-only-library.md) records architecture/security/packaging choices. [M1_VALIDATION.md](M1_VALIDATION.md) maps AC-002–AC-022 to actual evidence and explicit missing environments. README, PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, DEPENDENCIES.md, DECISIONS.md, CODEX_SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md, SKILLS.md and SPEC_CHANGELOG.md were updated. Skills applied: codebase-design, find-similar-functions (`rg` fallback), Impeccable and React Doctor; no new global skill installation.

**Bugs found and fixed:** closed stdin explicitly so helpers finish; preserved numeric-looking subseconds with ExifTool JSONQ; restored valid created-date fallback and inline offsets/fractions; superseded stale preview generations without wall-clock dependence; retained inventory across canceled/incomplete/offline scans. Actual case-insensitive APFS checks showed that realpath preserves caller spelling: overlap and application-data exclusions now also use native ancestor/directory identities. Regression fixtures reject nested case aliases and keep managed catalog/cache folders outside scan scope.

A repeated million-row stress run missed the 250 ms page/seek target because every request recounted the full inventory (page p95 300.9 ms; seek 347.9 ms under concurrent build load). Transactional inventory counts now supply exact ordinary page/root totals. The rerun measured page p95 2.13 ms at 100K rows and 1.83 ms at 1M; year-seek p95 5.20/1.92 ms. These are ordinary inventory queries, not a claim about all compound filters, cold-disk launches or a million decoded originals. Both runs are retained in `.context/evidence/`.

**Validation:** `npm run check` passed formatting, strict types, ESLint, six component tests, bindings drift, Rust fmt/clippy/tests and the production frontend build. The final safety additions passed seven library integration fixtures and clippy with warnings denied; the final workspace run covers 17 core unit tests, seven library tests and two process tests. Four native WKWebView tests passed with actual Rust scan/query/annotation IPC and cached-image protocol; only picker presentation uses a backend-issued generated selection. They verify no thumbnail work in text mode, minimum-window containment, Inspector focus handoff/return and 32 source entries unchanged. Partial results were observed while scanning. A 60-frame gallery scroll recorded p50/p95/max gaps of 20/21/21 ms; Long Tasks API was unavailable.

The normal unsigned `.app` bundle built. Its actual executable and bundled metadata resources passed an owned generated-library probe: 20 media records, JPEG/PNG/WebP PNG previews, embedded 1964 date/.1234 fraction/+05:30 offset, and 32 unchanged source entries. The first developer probe used a relative bundle path across a worker working-directory change; canonicalising that harness path fixed the failed probe. `release:check` verifies explicit production capabilities, test-server exclusion, test-route removal and every vendored helper hash. Rust audit reports zero vulnerability entries (two existing informational warnings); production npm audit reports zero, while nine existing high-severity development-tool entries remain documented. React Doctor is 100/100; Impeccable detector returned no findings. Final local Markdown links and owned untracked-file whitespace checks passed; all 265 packaged helper resource hashes matched the manifest. The binding generator now trims generated trailing whitespace consistently.

**Independent UI finish:** Pass. Query-failure retry without fake empty/stale results, Inspector failed-load retry, and compact Inspector keyboard continuity were each resolved, regression-tested and confirmed by the reviewer using refreshed captures/source/logs. The documenter updated DESIGN.md. The review did not establish VoiceOver or Windows behavior.

**App and artifacts:** reopened the normal workspace app, migrated the existing v1 catalog to v2, verified unchanged catalog UUID, retained pre-migration snapshot, zero registered roots and `integrity_check=ok`; no real photo folder was scanned as a development test. Native screenshots are `.context/screenshots/m1-{gallery,text-list,inspector,jobs,gallery-minimum,list-minimum}.png`. Actual logs, synthetic measurements, audits and app/migration evidence are under `.context/evidence/`.

**Remaining gates:** native Windows identity/traversal/scanning is unavailable; minimum macOS 13, clean-machine/system-Perl distribution, Intel, real removable-drive/provider-placeholder behavior, VoiceOver, controlled cold cached-gallery launch, large-catalog native scrolling and signed/notarized release remain unverified. RAW/HEIC/video, ICC-managed color and animated/multipage completeness are not claimed. Inputs over 32 MiB or dimensions over 12,000 are retained with unavailable previews. Stop before M2; original-file operations require separate authorisation and their plan/executor/independent-recovery prerequisites.

## 2026-10-27 — Simplify folder mode and scan filters

**Request:** rename “Enter hidden folders” to “Include hidden folders”; use switches instead of scan checkboxes; use tags instead of comma-separated filter input; remove scan From/Through dates; default folders to Managed with a Read only switch instead of a dropdown.

**Changes:** new folder setup defaults to Managed, while existing saved modes remain intact. Read only on saves referenced mode; off saves Managed. M1 continues to read originals in both modes. Hidden-file and hidden-folder switches remain independent; Include hidden folders permits scanning their contents under the remaining rules. Include/exclude patterns, excluded folder names and extensions now use labelled, removable tags. Enter, Tab and blur commit values; multiline paste, duplicate suppression, Backspace editing and IME composition are supported. Commas remain literal in brace globs and folder names. Save/Preview include an unfinished value without relying on blur. Busy forms disable editing.

Scan date controls are removed. Saving/rescanning clears legacy scan date bounds so an invisible restriction cannot exclude files. Browsing date filters remain available; native shared filter fields remain compatible. Existing identifiers, original-file guards and persisted folder modes are not migrated.

**Files and documentation:** `src/components/{Switch,TagInput}.tsx`, `src/library/RootSetup.tsx`, `src/styles.css`, component/native tests; updated CODEX_SPEC.md, ACCEPTANCE_TESTS.md, DECISIONS.md, DEVELOPMENT.md, M1_VALIDATION.md, SPEC_CHANGELOG.md, the existing ADR-0002 default statement, M1 task guidance and DESIGN.md. The Managed-default choice is explicitly owner-authorised and does not open an executor or mutation capability. Reused the existing scanner/IPC/filter arrays; no dependency or schema change.

**Validation:** all 11 component tests passed, including the five new settings regressions. Strict types and lint passed. `npm run check` passed, including 26 Rust tests, bindings drift, formatting and production frontend build. Four native WKWebView cases passed using backend-owned generated media: the Read only switch toggles; Enter adds tags without saving/scanning; Managed, the excluded-folder tag and null scan dates persist through actual Rust IPC; source manifests remain unchanged. Desktop and 660×560 settings captures show the top and scrolled filter sections without horizontal overflow. React Doctor scored 100/100; Impeccable detector returned `[]`. A confusing repeated placeholder beside an existing chip was changed to “Add another…” before final captures. Independent finish review passes the UI, with the documentation reconciliation completed in DESIGN.md.

**Artifacts and limits:** `.context/screenshots/scan-controls-{desktop,minimum,minimum-filters}.png`; `.context/evidence/scan-controls-*` logs. Normal unsigned macOS bundle and production capability/resource checks passed.
